expected: Idempotency, occupied port, stale PID, download/hash/space/config failures and safe cleanup.
limitations: Host-free tests run on POSIX; the Windows process-tree path was exercised on the real host by G16 and G20.
observed: tests.unit.test_lifecycle (15) pass: the lifecycle lock excludes a second process; stale PID/creation/executable mismatches are never treated as owned and are never signalled; stop terminates a real owned parent/child tree deepest first and is idempotent; start refuses an unowned occupied port and live owned processes without writing a launch record; keygen is private and never replaces a key; hash mismatch, size overrun and plain HTTP never promote a download; insufficient space fails before any download; status distinguishes not_installed/mismatched/stopped/failed.
